parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A circular wheel made of rubber attached to the lower rear side of the trashcan for mobility.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the trashcan to be rolled easily when tilted backward for transportation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axle to enable rolling motion.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A second circular wheel made of rubber located opposite the first wheel, providing balance and mobility.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the first wheel to stabilize and support the trashcan during movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axle to enable rolling motion.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A hinged cover made of HDPE that fits on top of the trashcan body.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and keeps debris and pests out of the trashcan.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main container structure of the trashcan made of HDPE, forming the storage compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and contains waste materials securely within the trashcan.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural support for the lid and wheels.
